payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged 4f21c43). Ports the media-placement seam: MediaHome{node_id,region,announced_ip}, the MediaPlacement trait, LocalMediaPlacement (single-box default), and ClusterMediaPlacement (bus-coordinated registry over the existing MediaPlacementClaim/Release envelopes — claim, lowest-nodeId tie-break, TTL self-heal, release-on-end). Injected into SfuMediaPlaneAdapter::new(backend, placement); allocate_session resolves region/announced-ip via placement (region_hint still wins) + stamps homeNodeId/announcedIp. Boot SFU/LiveKit arms default to LocalMediaPlacement::loopback(). 7 new tests (+ cluster suite green). Built by a subagent. The Rust re-implementation of FR-154.
